projects.title: Green Hash — Transparent Waste Management System
bullets: Designed and built a civic-tech platform with Supabase (PostgreSQL) backend, applying RDBMS schema design principles to structure community waste reporting data efficiently.
Implemented an admin dashboard for waste report management, community data visibility, and real-time status tracking.
Delivered end-to-end product development using agile practices and iterative engineering sprints.
Developed Stored Procedures (SP) and SQL packages to automate business logic and reporting workflows, translating functional requirements into reliable and scalable database solutions.
Wrote advanced queries using CTEs and cursors for complex multi-step data processing, and implemented triggers to enforce business rules and maintain data integrity automatically.
Built structured reports by joining large relational datasets, applying aggregations, and formatting output to meet business reporting standards.
Used SSMS and SQL Profiler for query performance tuning, execution plan analysis, and troubleshooting data issues in a production database environment.
Developed and deployed client websites using WordPress and Shopify; built creative carousels, portfolio pages, and landing pages that improved client engagement and brand presence.
Reviewed large volumes of business and market data to craft data-driven LinkedIn posts, articles, and blogs; communicated insights through compelling storytelling to grow audience engagement.
Produced technical writing including product documentation, blog posts, and outreach copy; drove SEO strategy and tracked campaign performance using Excel and Odoo CRM.
Built AI automation workflows using n8n, reducing manual reporting effort and improving operational efficiency across client campaigns.
